nodes.title: Note
widgets_values: The Image Size / Batch Size is set here BUT when loading an image without using the Resize Image group. - i2i (denoise) uses the input image as source and also it's resolution. - the image size doesn't matter when loading the image for the description only (image to prompt) when using the option latent in the Smart Model Loader (Chip Bar) - the latent size changes accordingly to what is used there (overwrites the configured values in Image Resolution and also uses it's own batch_size). The Latent type is auto detected in SML depending on the selected vae. Batch Size is now a seperate node because changing it inside Smart Folder or Image Resolution (the other variants) also changes the pipe and that forces a re-execution of e.g. Image Resize / Image to Prompt and everything else downstream. This way only the Initial Render re-executes. Batch Size has no Effect when using one of the I2I Options.

nodes.title: Note
widgets_values:
Enable one of the Load Image groups and use the preprocessor group. --- Both Subgraphs have a "SubGraph" Switch to Enable the nodes inside, use it before anything else.
after that choose the mode you want to use e.g. Standard / Standard + Union Types. You have to click the one you don't want to use, since both are active but only one is allowed. --- Standard ControlNets - select the controlnet model that fits your checkpoint (SD15/SDXL/SD3/Flux/Union) - Union is not working very well with illu or Pony use deticated models like depth or canny --- Diffsynth: Qwen Image / Z-Image Turbo: - change the model to qwen or zimage - don't use the controlnet with the Qwen Diff Lora (i2i Qwen Lora+PreProc)
- i'v removed i2i diff in the initial render group, since the model gets patched it works without encoding the ref image but you can use i2i denoise if you want the ref_image to be encoded too. - the prompt should be good otherwise you may get a mess. (use image to prompt if needed) --- for flux, i wouldn't recommend using controlnets. instead, i would use the loras, because they use less memory. [Flux Depth Lora](https://civitai.com/models/970050/flux-tools-depth-lora) / [Flux Canny Lora](https://civitai.com/models/970090?modelVersionId=1086214) leave the denoise in the initial render group at 1.0 to use the controlnet only.
